findings.title: Nil TopicUser crashes unsubscribe
findings.body: `TopicUser.find_by` returns nil when the user has no topic_users row for this topic, for example a user who was only mentioned or is watching via category. The next line then calls `tu.notification_level` on nil, raises NoMethodError, and the request fails with a 500. The code should create the row (e.g. via `TopicUser.change`) or handle the nil case.

findings.title: GET unsubscribe toggles state; repeat visits mute topic
findings.body: The unsubscribe action changes state on a GET request. A watching or tracking user is downgraded to regular on the first visit. Any later visit (a reload, an email link prefetcher, or a JSON refetch from the Ember route) drops them further to muted. That is unexpected data mutation and is also CSRF-able through an image tag. The level should be set idempotently, and the change should ideally require a POST or a token.

findings.title: unsubscribe_link now requires unsubscribe_url for all emails
findings.body: The shared `unsubscribe_link` string now interpolates `%{unsubscribe_url}`. Other mailers that use `add_unsubscribe_link`, such as the digest, do not pass that value. They will hit I18n MissingInterpolationArgument errors or render a broken "click here" link to a non-existent topic.

findings.title: Client route performs a second unsubscribe
findings.body: `loadTopicView` fetches `/t/:id.json`, not the unsubscribe endpoint. So the page shown is the topic view and the server unsubscribe happened only on the initial HTML load. The preloaded JSON is also stored under `topic_<id>`, so behavior depends on whether that preload is consumed. When the user navigates client-side to this route, no unsubscribe happens at all, even though the page says notifications will stop.

findings.title: Unescaped title rendering
findings.body: `stopNotificiationsText` is rendered with triple-stash `{{{ }}}`. Its content is built by interpolating `fancyTitle` into the translation. `fancyTitle` is escaped server-side, so this is safe only if every producer of that title escapes it. Translations are also injected raw.
